description.ja: 新作テレビアニメ『魔神創造伝ワタル』制作決定！
description.en: Production of the new TV anime “Mashin Souzouden Wataru” has been decided!

description.ja: 主人公「星部ワタル」の魔神「龍神丸」が登場！
description.en: The main character "Wataru Hoshibe "'s demon " Ryujinmaru" appears!

description.ja: • 部位ごとにパーツを分けられるシリーズ共通フレームを採用。他の魔神と組み合わせて遊ぼう！
description.en: • Adopts a common frame across the series that allows parts to be separated by area. Let's play in combination with other genies!

description.ja: • パチパチと手で外せるタッチゲート仕様。接着剤無しで組み立てられる！
description.en: • Touch gate design that can be removed by hand. Can be assembled without adhesive!

description.ja: • 武器はジョイントパーツを介して背面に取り付け可能。
description.en: • Weapons can be attached to the back via joint parts.

description.ja: • 頭部や登龍剣などはメタリックなゴールド成形色で再現。
description.en: • The head and dragon sword are reproduced in metallic gold molding color.
